name: Hammurabi
source:
"What does it mean to you to be a ruler?"

Based on Hammurabi, who was the sixth Amorite king of Babylon (that is, of the First Babylonian Dynasty, the Amorite Dynasty) from 1792 BC to 1750 BC middle chronology. He became the first king of the Babylonian Empire following the abdication of his father, Sin-Muballit, who had become very ill and died, extending Babylon's control over Mesopotamia by winning a series of wars against neighboring kingdoms.

The hero governing the Ancient City State of Babylonia. Hammurabi despises wars and waits for the appearance of a ruler who can unite the world. In contrast to her intimidating looks, she is very mindful and graceful lady. Every ability of hers from household chores to etiquette is at the maximum value. Is draped in virtue and thoughtfulness, making her perfect hero.

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/eiyuusenki/char.html#char16a]English official site[/url]]
